findings: Enforce cross-source snapshot integrity in application/finding_risk_context.py. AssetContext and Threat Intelligence facts exposed at top level must be consistent with the facts and provenance used by correlation. Either compose one authoritative snapshot without changing frozen authorities or explicitly compare independently returned AssetContext/TI content and provenance against the correlation result and fail closed on mismatch. Finding-ID equality alone is insufficient.

Expand focused application authority tests to cover resolved AssetContext with exact provenance, missing identifier, unknown asset, complete applicable TI, incomplete/unavailable TI, Evidence identifier/kind/type/version/reference round-trip, duplicated or mismatched source results, every risk-input state, source-integrity failure, and guards proving legacy Decision/Impact/Recommendation/AI paths are not invoked.

Expand API authority tests to cover successful typed response projection, Evidence/provenance and risk-input transport, timeout 504, invalid TI response handling, integrity failure, and proof that fabricated result fields are absent/null/empty in the real response mapper.

Expand frontend parser/lifecycle/rendering tests to cover risk-context loading and controlled error states, successful workspace rendering, same-selection stale suppression, canonical asset/provenance rendering, TI completeness/provenance, canonical Evidence metadata/input references, all five risk inputs exactly once, contradictory state rejection, Evidence-ready versus Risk-insufficient separation, and absence of legacy decision requests or client-side risk arithmetic.

Preserve current fail-closed behavior: score/priority/business_impact/decision remain null and recommendations remain empty whenever context is insufficient. Do not introduce a new risk engine or modify frozen Finding, AssetContext, TI, correlation, RiskReadiness, Decision, BusinessImpact, Recommendation, AI, settings, runtime, or .env authorities.
